specialty_focus: HeartSmart operates as a multi-brand medical supplier and CMS-designated Independent Diagnostic Testing Facility (IDTF), specializing in cardiac telemetry and remote monitoring services. It also serves as a one-stop shop for automated external defibrillators (AEDs) and related emergency medical supplies, offering value-added services like training and program management.
